decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display sits at the core of the announced display focus and needed little extra investment, so management keeps it even though it has not been visible on the website since 2019.
The pegboard-back display extends the core shelf range and runs on existing capacity, so management keeps it and attributes the weaker visibility to pandemic-related disruption in retail promotion.
The eighth-pallet size completes the pallet range the firm has committed to, which justifies keeping it despite its absence from the website in 2020 and 2021.

The media-product niche is shrinking structurally rather than temporarily, and the product has had no visible presence for two years, so even a committed management can no longer justify it and moves its resources back to the core display business.
